# Three service packages, one batch run

mgvideo batch turns a three-item catalogue into three vertical 9:16 offer videos in the Magnifito brand, with title and price claims generated per SKU. ffmpeg joins the three renders into one 16:9 contact reel.

- Type: Commerce variants
- Skill: `magnifito-variants`
- Engine: `batch`
- Output: 1920x1080, 15 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/04-commerce-variants.mp4`](../videos/04-commerce-variants.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-variants skill to run a commerce batch for Magnifito over catalog.json: three demo service packages (Starter Website Package, Social Media Care, Email Automation Kit) with EUR prices and discounts. Render every SKU in the Magnifito brand kit next to the catalogue (brand.json, Geist, the logo) with the brand-title recipe and the closing line "Talk to us at magnifito.com", and let batch write the title and price claims for each SKU. Then put the three 9:16 videos side by side in one 15-second 16:9 reel on the Magnifito cream backdrop, with rounded corners, a soft dip between scenes, soft shadows, a staggered rise-in, and a header card rendered by HyperFrames.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- 04-commerce-variants
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/04-commerce-variants/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo batch catalog.json --concurrency 3 --force
node collect-run.mjs runs/magnifito-packages-2026/MGF-WEB-01/runs work/sku-web.mp4
node collect-run.mjs runs/magnifito-packages-2026/MGF-SOC-01/runs work/sku-social.mp4
node collect-run.mjs runs/magnifito-packages-2026/MGF-EML-01/runs work/sku-email.mp4
mgvideo render . --codec mov_prores --force
node collect-run.mjs runs work/header.mov
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=320x180:r=30:d=15,format=gray,geq=lum='255*exp(-(pow(X-(0.28*W+0.10*W*sin(T*0.5)),2)+pow(Y-(0.80*H+0.10*H*cos(T*0.4)),2))/(2*pow(0.26*W,2)))'" -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=320x180:r=30:d=15,format=gray,geq=lum='255*exp(-(pow(X-(0.80*W+0.08*W*cos(T*0.35)),2)+pow(Y-(0.18*H+0.08*H*sin(T*0.45)),2))/(2*pow(0.30*W,2)))'" -f lavfi -i "color=c=0xf0eadf:s=320x180:r=30:d=15" -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=1920x1080:r=30:d=0.04" -filter_complex "[0]format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.11:gg=0.15:bb=0.18[g1];[1]format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.05:gg=0.07:bb=0.08[g2];[2]format=gbrp[base];[base][g1]blend=all_mode=subtract[m];[m][g2]blend=all_mode=subtract,scale=1920:1080:flags=bicubic[soft];[3]format=gray,geq=lum='255*clip(1.9-hypot(mod(X,40)-20,mod(Y,40)-20),0,1)',loop=loop=-1:size=1,trim=duration=15,setpts=N/30/TB,format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.16:gg=0.2:bb=0.22[dots];[soft][dots]blend=all_mode=subtract,noise=alls=2:allf=t,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -t 15 -c:v libx264 -crf 12 -preset veryfast work/bg.mp4
ffmpeg -i work/bg.mp4 -i work/header.mov -i work/sku-web.mp4 -i work/sku-social.mp4 -i work/sku-email.mp4 -f lavfi -i
```
